responses.text: Can't grow crops if they don't give us the water.
Don't know about you, but this beats herding Brahmin back in California.
If I don't get more water soon, I won't make my quota this season.
I'm glad the troopers are smart enough not to trample everything.
Something - or someone - has been chewing on the coyote tobacco again.
The maize is doing well in this soil.
We're finally getting all the water we're supposed to. It's about time.
Word is they're sending some of us home since we're not making the quota.
